description: This header file 'pager.h' declares interfaces for managing a pager utility within a repository context, including functions for setup, waiting, checking pager status, and configuring pager arguments.

methods.name: git_pager
methods.description: Returns the pager command for the given repository and output context.

methods.name: setup_pager
methods.description: Initializes or configures the pager for the repository.

methods.name: wait_for_pager
methods.description: Waits for the pager process to complete.

methods.name: pager_in_use
methods.description: Checks if a pager is currently being used.

methods.name: term_columns
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the terminal.

methods.name: term_clear_line
methods.description: Clears the current line in the terminal.

methods.name: decimal_width
methods.description: Calculates the width needed to display a given unsigned integer.

methods.name: check_pager_config
methods.description: Checks the configuration of the pager command in the repository context.

methods.name: prepare_pager_args
methods.description: Prepares arguments for the child process to invoke the pager.
